guides.title: Add a vehicle or asset
guides.blurb: Register a vehicle, tractor or machine with its reading, license and service interval.

steps.title: Vehicles
steps.text: Click Vehicles.

steps.title: Add Asset
steps.text: Click Add Asset.

steps.title: Name and asset tag
steps.text: A name drivers recognise, and its tag or registration.

steps.title: Type and tracking
steps.text: What it is, and whether it's tracked in kilometres or machine hours. A sub-contractor's asset is linked to them.

steps.title: Current reading
steps.text: The odometer or hour meter now. Fuel logs check the next reading against it.

steps.title: Service and license
steps.text: Service interval, last service and license expiry, for the audits.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Click to register it (or cancel if you're only practising).

guides.title: Register a depot and its pumps
guides.blurb: A tank with its fuel type and size, and the pumps that dispense from it.

steps.title: Fuel Depots
steps.text: Click Fuel Depots.

steps.title: Add Depot / Tank
steps.text: Click Add Depot / Tank.

steps.title: 1. Tank details
steps.text: Name and location of the tank.

steps.title: Fuel type and size
steps.text: What it holds and its size in litres. Tick external for a supplier's tank or a filling station.

steps.title: 2. Connected pumps
steps.text: Add each pump with its current meter reading. Fuel issued is checked against the meter.

steps.title: Save Depot & Pumps
steps.text: Click to register it (or cancel if you're only practising).

guides.title: Set the fuel price
guides.blurb: Add a price per litre from a date, so costs are right.

steps.title: Management
steps.text: Click Management.

steps.title: Fuel Pricing
steps.text: Click Fuel Pricing.

steps.title: Fuel type
steps.text: Which fuel the price is for.

steps.title: Price and date
steps.text: The price per litre and the date it applies from. An earlier date re-costs fuel from then.

steps.title: Save Price
steps.text: Adds it to the price history.

guides.title: Plan a delivery or collection
guides.blurb: Set up a stop for a driver: the client, what goes (or comes back) and who takes it.

steps.title: Deliveries
steps.text: Click Deliveries.

steps.title: New Delivery
steps.text: Click New Delivery.

steps.title: Delivery or collection
steps.text: A delivery takes goods to the client; a collection brings goods back.

steps.title: Client and reference
steps.text: Pick the client and add your invoice or order number - it is printed on the ePOD.

steps.title: Driver and vehicle
steps.text: Give it to one driver, or leave Anyone so the first driver who opens it on the phone takes it.

steps.title: Lines
steps.text: Each product (or free text), the quantity and the unit. The driver records what was actually handed over.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Click Save. The stop appears on the driver's phone at the next sync.

guides.title: Resolve a partial or failed stop
guides.blurb: Deal with what was not delivered: write it off, or send it on a new stop.

steps.title: Deliveries
steps.text: Click Deliveries.

steps.title: Resolve
steps.text: Click Resolve.

steps.title: Waiting stops
steps.text: Each partial or failed stop with what is outstanding. Click Resolve on one.

steps.title: Close or move on
steps.text: Close as is writes off what is outstanding. The other button makes a new stop with only the outstanding goods. A failed stop stays marked failed either way.

guides.title: Collect goods back
guides.blurb: Fetch goods back from a client after a delivery.

steps.title: Deliveries
steps.text: Click Deliveries.

steps.title: Find the delivery
steps.text: On a delivered stop, click the arrow (Collect back).

steps.title: What comes back
steps.text: The quantities still at the client are filled in - anything already collected is left out. Change them if needed, pick a date and driver, and create the collection.

guides.title: Send or resend an ePOD
guides.blurb: Open the proof of delivery PDF, or email it again.

steps.title: Deliveries
steps.text: Click Deliveries.

steps.title: Open or email
steps.text: On a finished stop the PDF icon opens the ePOD and the envelope emails it - to the client's saved address, or to one you type.

steps.title: Did it go?
steps.text: Click ePOD Emails to see every send and any that failed. Client email addresses are set under Management, Clients, Contact.
